newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists allocated 200 bln lire of Italy CCTs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists allocated 200 bln lire of Italy CCTs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders were allocated 200 billion lire of variable-rate certificates (CCT) against bids for 800 billion and the Italian Treasury's offer of 200 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 6.786 trillion lire at the open auction for the new March 1, 2004 paper, against 2.0 trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The auction price was set at 99.10 giving a gross yield of 7.01 percent.
